entries.Abigail: What do you think of my snow-goon?
entries.Abigail_spouse_y2: Imagine if we lived in an igloo together!$h#$e#It would be fun, but I'm happy living anywhere with you.$l
entries.Abigail_y2: Have you ever thrown a bunch of pebbles on a frozen lake? It makes a very nice sound.#$e#...Don't tell my dad, but I'm wearing the Winter Star sweater under this coat.
entries.Alex: Snowmen are okay, I guess. But mostly I'm looking forward to the spring.
entries.Alex_spouse: I'll be rooting for you in the fishing competition.
entries.Alex_spouse_y2: Hey! You're going to win by a longshot today, I know it. Make us proud!
entries.Alex_y2: You think anyone would mind if I took a dip in the frozen lake after the festival?#$e#I've heard ice baths are good for the muscles.
entries.Caroline: How's winter coming along for you, @?$h
entries.Caroline_y2: Hi, @. Are you finding any time to relax from your farming duties this winter?$0
entries.Clint: Emily started helping me without any provocation... does that mean something? *gulp*$4
entries.Clint_y2: These lumps of snow won't form into balls...$0#$e#I think I'm better working in the heat than in the cold.$2
entries.Demetrius: You know what? I probably should've worn a jacket.
entries.Demetrius_y2: Water ice... a most profound substance, indeed. Necessary for life, it makes a fitting material for statuary meant to represent the living form.

entries.Elliott: I'm entering the ice fishing competition today. Why not?#$e#It's rare that Willy ever loses, though.
entries.Elliott_spouse: I know you'll beat me in the fishing competition, but I don't mind. I'm just here for the fun of it.$h
entries.Elliott_spouse_y2: I've been practicing my fishing technique. I won't hold back against you, my dear.$1
entries.Elliott_y2: Look here, it's my secret weapon... a flask of fine spirits, to wet my lips a moment before the whistle sounds...
entries.Emily: Wow, this snowman needs a makeover. Who made this?$s
entries.Emily_spouse_y2: Ta da! It's you!#$e#What? You don't see the resemblance? I think it's perfect!
entries.Emily_y2: A snowman has to look the part! Isn't the top hat and scarf stylish?
entries.Evelyn: Did I ever tell you how George and I first met? He actually pelted me with a snowball in this very festival.#$e#He was a gentleman back then, and came over to see if I was okay.$h
entries.Evelyn_y2: You never know... this could be the last time I ever make a snowman with Alex.#$e#Life is short, dear. Make sure to treasure every moment.
entries.George: Hmmph... Wife dragged me out into the cold for this?
entries.George_y2: When you get old and bald like me, you need a good, warm hat.
entries.Gus: Sorry there's no food.#$e#Just wait until the Feast of the Winter Star. You'll be stuffed for days.
entries.Gus_y2: I've been spending too much time holed up inside, watching Gridball... it's good to get outside in the crisp winter air.
entries.Haley: I guess Winter isn't all bad... playing in the snow can be fun!
entries.Haley_spouse: Brr... my hands are freezing from making this snowman.$l
entries.Haley_spouse_y2: Come here, let me fix your hair... I'm going to take an action shot of you during the contest!
entries.Haley_y2: I'm glad I wore earmuffs, it's freezing out here!$0#$e#I brought my camera this year. It's perfect lighting for a winter photoshoot!
entries.Harvey: Extreme temperatures can put your body under a lot of stress, so make sure to bundle up!#$e#Oh, and enjoy the festival!$h
entries.Harvey_spouse: I'm dreaming of our warm fire back home...$l
entries.Harvey_spouse_y2: Hi, honey. Good luck today in the ice fishing contest.$0
entries.Harvey_y2: I shouldn't have waxed my moustache this morning, it's frozen solid! Oh dear...$2#$e#Well, if you need an ice pick, you know where to find me...$h
entries.Jas: I wanna give him a carrot nose!$h
entries.Jas_y2: Don't the fish get cold under there?$3
entries.Jodi: The forest looks beautiful in the winter, doesn't it?
entries.Jodi_y2: Gatherings like this are a good way to build community with our neighbors.#$e#It's nice how cold weather seems to bring people together.
entries.Kent_y2: You ready for the contest? We all think you're going to win.
entries.Leah: Oh, ice. A beautiful material to sculpt in, but so impermanent.#$e#But I guess that might make the art even better.
entries.Leah_spouse_y2: Someday, I should teach you how to sculpt with ice! It would be fun!$h#$e#I'd be very curious to see what you'd come up with.
entries.Leah_y2: You have to temper ice before cutting it, otherwise you can't shape it!
entries.Leo: You could make an igloo twice as warm if you stuffed feathers in the walls!
entries.Leo_y2: *crunch* *crunch* Snow makes a funny noise when you step on it!$1
entries.Lewis: Welcome to the Festival of Ice!#$e#The highlight of today's festival is the ice fishing competition. We set up this 'frozen lake' and stocked it full of fish.#$b#Just let me know when you're ready to compete.
entries.Lewis_y2: Hello, @. It's that time of the year again for the ice fishing festival.#$b#Speak with me when you're ready to start the competition!$1
entries.Linus: Igloo-building's an art I picked up from the tundra dwellers who live beyond the frozen sea.#$e#That was many years ago.$h#$e#An Igloo makes a nice home, but it's easier to just stay in my tent year-round.
entries.Linus_y2: Ahh... The forest has entered her long slumber for the winter...$1
entries.Marlon_y2: This time of year isn't so bad. No bugs during winter...#$e#Think you can beat Willy this year? He's a tough competitor...
entries.Marnie: I feel bad for all the poor, cold animals out there.$s
entries.Marnie_y2: Aww... That piggy looks adorable all bundled up!$1
entries.Maru: I'm not very creative when it comes to snowmen.$s
entries.Maru_spouse_y2: You'll do great out there, honey! Just stay calm and focused.
entries.Maru_y2: The key to making a well-crafted snowman begins with ensuring a level foundation and avoiding excessive weight on the upper section.$3
entries.OtherPlayerWin: message "I didn't win the competition, but it was still fun! Time to head home."/waitForOtherPlayers festivalEnd/end
entries.Pam: I plan on winning the ice fishing competition!#$e#Willy is gonna be pretty hard to beat, though... He does this kinda stuff day and night.$s
entries.Pam_y2: $y 'I lost last year because I chose a bad spot. I have a good feeling things will be different this time around._I don't think the location matters._Hah. Says you! I'll prove you wrong._I'll beat you anyway._...$4_Well, good luck._Same to you, kid.'
entries.Penny: $y 'Hmm... What kind of snowman should we make?_A classic one. Carrot nose, top-hat, scarf._I guess maybe it's best to stick with the classics, huh?$h_Something funky. Icicle antennas, pine cone eyes._Okay! That sounds like fun.$h_Snowmen are boring. Think outside of the box!_Um, okay... I think I might stick with something more conventional.'
entries.Penny_spouse: Are you entering the fishing contest this year, @? My mom's pretty serious about winning.
entries.Penny_spouse_y2: When we get home, let's make a fire and have some hot cocoa.$0#$e#...with marshmallows?$h
entries.Penny_y2: I'm too nervous to walk on the frozen lake...#$e#I read a book once, where a girl fell through the ice.#$b#She was okay! But... I've been cautious about it ever since.
entries.Pierre: This snow is so cold I can't feel my fingers anymore...$s
entries.Pierre_y2: Our family has matching Winter Star sweaters.#$e#Now, if only Abigail would wear hers...$2
entries.Robin: I'm sorry, but carving ice parapets requires my undivided attention!
entries.Robin_y2: Ice sculpting is a rewarding challenge for me. It's a distinct material that I'm not used to!
entries.Sam: Hey, @. Are you gonna enter the ice fishing competition?#$e#Oh, not me. I don't know how to fish.
entries.Sam_spouse: Aren't you cold? Are you sure you don't want my jacket?
entries.Sam_spouse_y2: You should teach me how to use a fishing rod sometime. I think I'd be good at it.
entries.Sam_y2: Hey, why are you laughing? He's not even done yet!#$e#You just wait... once we're finished, he'll be one fine snowman.
entries.Sandy: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
entries.Sebastian: Cold? Nah, I never get cold.
entries.Sebastian_spouse: Don't worry about me, I never get cold...
entries.Sebastian_spouse_y2: Hey, you really need to win the contest today.$0#$e#Uh... well, I guess I made a little bet with Marlon...$1
entries.Sebastian_y2: You ever notice how quiet it is in the snow?
entries.Shane: If it was up to me, I'd probably have a pizza festival at the saloon, instead...
entries.Shane_spouse_y2: Remember when we sat at the old pond and shared a beer? That was around here somewhere.#$e#Well, it's best not to dwell in the past... even the good memories bring me pain.
entries.Shane_y2: Winter can be really hard on animals. Did you install heaters in your coops and barns?
entries.Vincent: I saw a big fish down there!
entries.Vincent_y2: My big brother is helping me build a snowman!$0
entries.Willy: $y 'Hey, @. Ready for some ice fishing?_Yes. I'll do my best!_That's the spirit!$h_Yes, and I'm going to beat you!_We'll see.$h_To be honest, no. I'm bad at fishing._Well, then think of it as good practice!$h'
entries.Willy_y2: Aye, the whole town'll be watchin' our little tournament today. Let's give them all a good show.
entries.Wizard: Sneaking off to visit my weird tower? You're odd for a mundane.
entries.Wizard_y2: Hmm? How did you get here?#$e#Pay no attention to me. I'm simply observing...
